workflow.name: Pre-release quality gate
workflow.description: Before shipping a build: test the API, check performance, analyse results, then get a go/no-go call.

steps.prompt:
We are about to release: {{input}}

Design and describe a focused API test plan for the endpoints most at risk (contract, auth, error handling, rate limits, edge cases). List the concrete test cases and what a failure would mean.

Based on this risk analysis, write a go/no-go release recommendation: blocking issues, acceptable risks, a rollback plan, and a launch-day checklist.
